'''''Star Wars: Battle of Jakku — Republic Under Siege''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] limited series, and the second of three limited series known as ''[[Star Wars: Battle of Jakku]]''. It is set between [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Episode VI Return of the Jedi'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Episode VII The Force Awakens'']] and tells the story of the [[Galactic Civil War]] after the [[Battle of Endor]] leading up to the [[Battle of Jakku]]. It is written by [[Alex Segura]] and illustrated by [[Stefano Raffaele]] and [[Jethro Morales]] and was published by [[Marvel Comics]] beginning on [[November 20]], [[2024]].
